cross_source_caveats: Product join is string 1C code; leading zeroes and trailing underscore are meaningful raw characters. Supplier article is a separate key.
Monthly reports have 33 months 2024-01..2026-09 and separate total column/row; September 2026 is partial. Blank values are not automatically zero.
Monthly stock is beginning balance; not current free stock and not stockout duration.
Transaction quantity has 18 blank values, 115 negative values and 171470 positive values, excluding total row.
MOQ has 1938 rows, 1937 unique codes; code 270400035_ duplicates and 15 saved #N/A results. All E data cells are external VLOOKUP formulas.
Transit 2641 physical rows: code populated in 2623, supplier article in 2641, name in 2621; 2616 unique nonempty codes. Keep rows lacking internal code for mapping review.
Transit quantities use 6 document columns with deadline dates in headers; 300 coded rows have nonzero quantity. Document date is not actual dispatch date or normative lead time.

Seasonality amount unit/currency not explicitly supplied; do not label it quantity or KZT without confirmation. 2026 source has nine filled months; future zeroes in derived formulas differ from blank raw months.
Catalog categories exist only in the external-link cache of MOQ, not a native task worksheet; different from sales-management category. Cache should not be auto-imported as authoritative input.
No client ID, explicit normative lead time, daily availability/stockout days, reservation or current free stock in the six native IEK sheets.
